As nature's most versatile and potent plants, herbs can be used in hundreds of ways to add zest and vitality to your life. Inspiring you with a bounty of innovative ideas and recipes, Llewellyn's 2017 Herbal Almanac offers dozens of articles that explore many ways of using herbs. Cultivate a radiant spirit and a healthy life. Try delicious new recipes. Create healing salves and lotions. This friendly guide features hands-on projects, fresh ideas, and advice for herb enthusiasts of all skill levels

"Herbs for growing & gathering, cooking & crafts, health & beauty, history, myth & lore"--Cover
